diagnosis: All 10 invoices failed for the same reason. After type_item and the press_return reflex, the dropdown is still open and the cursor is still in the Item cell (S10, S32, S94). Jev then chose type_amount (conf 0.46-0.57, runner_up click_item) without clicking the Rate cell. The amount landed in the Item cell ('Al Models & API10.' S12, 'SaaS Subscription4' S34, 'Cloud & Hosting25.' S76).

Jev repeated type_amount 3 to 5 times in a row (inv 22, 24, 25, 27, 28, 29, 30 steps 11-15). The post-typing Tab moved focus Item -> Tax -> Quantity -> Rate, so the amount also landed in Tax (x≈646, S36, S78) and Quantity (x≈912-925, S38, S80). Grand Total stayed $0.00.

Clicking '$0.00' at [1079,471] and then type_amount works: Rate and Grand Total became $10.00 (inv 21 steps 12-13, S14) and $258.42 (inv 23 steps 14-15, S58). Those two invoices still failed only because the Item cell had already been corrupted by the first stray type_amount.

Save -> 'Yes' on a corrupted item always gives 'Not Found: Item value <name><amount> does not exist' (S16, S40, S60, ...). Jev then looped Save/Yes/Okay/Escape until max_steps, 20 or more wasted steps per invoice. Each loop burned a PINV number (PINV-1001 to 1043).
The save dialog warns 'Entry has Grand Total $0.00. Please verify amounts' (S39, S81, ...). Jev clicked Yes anyway; the right answer is No, then fix the rate.

A repair path is visible. Clicking the corrupted item cell reopens the dropdown with the four clean names at y≥520 (S104, S174). Clicking the clean name restores the item (S105, S176). Jev then ruined it again by choosing type_amount without clicking Rate (inv 25 step 21, inv 28 step 22).

Other traps: a second 'Add Row' gives 'Mandatory Error ... Items Row 2' on every save (inv 26 step 17, S134). Clicking the 'Rate' header changes nothing (inv 24 steps 32-35). Clicking the date line again reopens the calendar (inv 27).

Read: inv 29 again picked '$50.00 USD due May 1, 2026' and produced 2026.00. WellyBox (inv 23) was read as USD from '$258.42' and marked wrong; an earlier block had the same amount as 'N258.42', so WellyBox is likely ILS.
